# Conditions

Read condition names from the supplied state and apply only their stated consequences.

- Incapacitated prevents actions, Bonus Actions, and Reactions and breaks Concentration.
- Grappled and Restrained set Speed to 0; Restrained also changes attacks and Dexterity saving throws.
- Prone changes movement and attack rolls according to distance.
- Frightened can hinder attacks and checks while its source is visible and prevents willing movement closer to that source.
- Invisible affects sight-dependent perception and targeting as well as attack rolls.

Treat a condition as a current constraint or opportunity, not as proof that it will persist through the whole round. Do not invent an ending rule or escape attempt.
